//: Census of what this programme has NOT derived. Consumed by research/toe_census.py. See docs/TOE_ROADMAP.md for how this is meant to be used.

//statuses.undetermined: Nothing in the corpus fixes it: a free function, a free parameter, or an acknowledged gap.
//statuses.chosen: A form or model was picked for the formalisation and is not derived from anything below it.
//statuses.identified: Fixed by a matching condition (two constructions agree) rather than derived from a principle.
//statuses.postulate: Declared model data on purpose, named as such (`law_*`, `PhotonMass := 0`, legacy constants). Not a defect; it is the inventory of what physics is assumed.
//statuses.external: Fixed by measurement, not by the theory (e.g. the observed Planck length).
//statuses.derived: Proved from lower layers with no remaining freedom.

//open: `undetermined`, `chosen` and `identified` are the OPEN statuses: the distance between here and a TOE is that list. `postulate` items are counted separately -- they are the assumptions, not the gaps.
//ratchet: max_open and max_carried_laws may only be lowered. Raising one is allowed but must be a visible diff with a stated reason, exactly like carrier_cap in lean_proofs/statement_audit.json.

items.name: Φ as a functional of Q-region data
items.note: The single load-most-bearing gap. ℓ_P(Φ), the metric, the radial dictionary and every RCOD measurement are functions of Φ; if Φ is not defined from microscopic data, they are a family of parameterised models, not a theory. Two candidate routes (Choi-state, relative-entropy) are recorded in Technical §1.1; neither is adopted as a construction.

items.name: Φ ↔ s dictionary (to the relative-entropy-density scalar)
items.note: Route B adopts EDG's construction as a building block but no Φ→s map exists, so none of EDG's laboratory consequences transfer. Recorded in PREDICTIONS_REGISTER as a blocking feasibility item.

items.name: ρ₀, the critical saturation density
items.note: Free parameter of the density-driven profile. No independent determination or bound exists anywhere in the corpus.

items.name: ℓ_P0, the vacuum Planck length
items.note: Set from observation rather than derived. Acceptable for a candidate theory, but it means the profile is a rescaling of a measured constant, not a prediction of it.

items.name: ℓ_P(ρ) = ℓ_P0/√(1 + ρ/ρ₀)
items.note: Stated model assumption with formally checked properties (positivity, strict monotonicity, saturation). The properties are theorems; the profile is not. docs/PLANCK_PROFILE_MATCHING.md gives an analytic matching condition, not a physical derivation; the Lean bridge checks only conditional properties, not existence.

items.name: ℓ_P(Φ) = ℓ_P0·√(1 − Φ²)
items.note: Same status: the collapse at Φ=1 and the monotonicity are proved, the form is chosen. No independent argument selects √(1−Φ²) over the many monotone alternatives. The analytic matching condition in docs/PLANCK_PROFILE_MATCHING.md is not a physical derivation; the Lean bridge checks only conditional properties, not existence.

items.name: κ(Φ) = (1 + Φ)²/√(1 − Φ²)
items.note: Fixed by requiring the ℓ_P-based radial metric to reproduce the isotropic conformal factor. Identified, not derived: the requirement is a matching condition, and RadialDilation records that ℓ_P alone gives g_RR = (1−Φ²)² with negative quasi-local mass and no linear term.

items.name: Φ* = (√5 − 1)/2, the golden-ratio bottleneck
items.note: The disformal causality band is *placed* at the golden ratio. The sharpness theorem (equality iff Φ = Φ*) is proved; nothing derives the value.

items.name: freezeBoundaryThreshold := 0.012
items.note: A literal in the axiom layer. The theorems around it are `Iff.rfl` because the threshold is a definition; the number itself has no derivation or measurement behind it.

items.name: γ in İ = −γ·A_BH^κ·I
items.note: Phenomenological ansatz; the classical area theorem gives no rate. It is fitted in the simulation suite, not predicted.

items.name: κ in the depletion law
items.note: The candidate action does not determine γ or κ(Φ) (Technical §3). One toy κ(Φ) comes from the Markov model and one effective κ from the Ising fit.

items.name: H(A_BH), the horizon information content
items.note: No covariant derivation and no independent measurement. The depletion story is built on it.

items.name: ξ, the scalar–curvature coupling
items.note: Registered Open Problem 1: the JBD identification embraces non-minimal coupling while the adopted EDG route suppresses it. Both cannot be operative at the same scales, and the corpus says so.

items.name: The Q-region carrier model (singleton / zero-information)
items.note: The model that makes the corpus provable is degenerate: information, distance, flux and asymmetry are identically zero in it, and 33 of 163 audited statements are true only from data the model carries. Chosen for formalisation; replacing it with a non-degenerate carrier is the largest single piece of work in the programme.

items.name: The macroscopic spatial metric from Φ
items.note: The explicit Markov and entangled-chain diagnostics both show a decay-rate trend opposite to the Schwarzschild-required trend. Neither is a continuum derivation, and the ledger records both as Open.

items.name: PhotonMass := 0
items.note: Model postulate, named and docstringed. The theorem `photonMass_eq_zero` is `rfl`: a restatement, not a derivation, and the rename pass says so in its name.

items.name: Legacy density constants (Ω_b, Ω_DM, Ω_Λ summing to 1)
items.note: Flatness is the constant 1, not a derived property. Renamed from `flat_universe_sum` precisely because the old name implied otherwise.
